wallpaperStudioHint: Download one in a click. Credit: 4kwallpapers.com
magnificationHint: Icons grow as the pointer passes over them.
autoHideHint: Rest the pointer at the Dock's edge to reveal it, on any display.
genieHint: While it is on, windows do not use the Windows animations for maximizing or closing.
genieSpeedHint: How long windows take to fly into the dock and back.
genieOffHint: Turn on Animation effects in Windows to play this effect.
menuBarHint: Time, battery, and access to the Windows quick settings and notifications.
menuBarAutoHideHint: Rest the pointer at the bar's screen edge to reveal it.
menuBarMusicHint: Music and video, with controls. With music and AI off, the island disappears.
islandStyleHint: Choose between the centered notch or a compact bubble next to the status indicators.
islandPresetHint: How big the island is and how far its panel opens. Classic is the original size.
islandPresetLive: Preview: the island opens as it will on your bar.
launchpadOnHint: The dock's Start button and the hotkey open a full-screen app grid with search. Off opens the Windows Start menu.
launchpadHotkeyHint: Press it again to close. Example: Ctrl+Alt+Space. Leave empty for none.
hotkeyInvalid: Not a valid hotkey. Use at least one of Ctrl, Alt, Shift or Win, then a key.
dragMotionHint: While you move a window: a soft shadow behind it, a preview where it would snap at a screen edge, and a spring into place on release. Windows does not allow tilting another program's window.
accessoryBatteryHint: Supported mice and headsets. No device queries while off.
aiUsageHint: Uses your existing sessions; checks every 5 min. Never saves credentials.
menuBarBluetoothHint: Show Bluetooth status and open settings beside Wi-Fi.
menuBarBatteryPercentHint: Display the charge percentage next to the battery icon.
menuBarTaskViewHint: Show Task View to manage open windows and virtual desktops.
saveError: The settings could not be saved.
checkUpdatesHint: Asks GitHub for the newest release. This is the only network request Whirlpool makes.
updatesError: Could not check. Check your connection.
showRecentsHint: The last three you opened that are not pinned.
mascot: Crab on special moments (off by default)
mascotHint: A small crab can mark AI plan changes and energy saver. It no longer appears for the charger.
resetHint: Back to the out-of-the-box look and behavior. Your pinned apps stay.
updateBannerBody: It brings improvements and fixes. It installs in seconds and the dock comes back on its own.
updateInstallError: The update could not be installed. Check your connection and try again.
shortcutsFolderHint: Open a folder's contents from the Dock.
githubError: Could not open GitHub. Try again.
animationStyleHint: How springs move: floaty, original or crisp.
startupAnimationHint: How the dock arrives, and sinks away when you quit.
chargingAnimationHint: Play an animation when you connect the charger.
hudEnabledHint: A small pill when the volume, Wi-Fi or Bluetooth changes.
mediaKeyHookHint: Whirlpool changes the volume itself, so the Windows flyout does not open. It reads no other key and stores or sends none.
wallpapersHint: Fourteen photographs from Pexels, stored in the app. Click one to set it.
wallpaperFailed: Windows did not accept that wallpaper.
barStyleHint: Docked runs edge to edge. Floating is a rounded bar inset from the screen edges.
barInsetHint: How far a floating bar stays from the left and right edges.
barGapHint: The space above a floating bar.
chargingStyleHint: Surge: a small medallion with thin rings. Halo: a slim capsule. Edge: the screen edges glow, green, yellow or orange by level. Tide: a line of light along the top.
barTintHint: The tint laid over the glass.
barBorderHint: A thin line along the bar's edge.
barWidthHint: A narrower floating bar leaves room on the sides.
barEdgeHint: Put the bar on the top or the bottom of the screen. On the bottom its island opens upward as a bubble.
subtitleDock: Size, motion and behavior of the dock.
subtitlePersonalize: Animations, charging effects, menu bar look and wallpapers.
subtitleWindows: How Whirlpool treats your open windows.
subtitleMenuBar: Position, size, items and the dynamic island.
subtitleClock: Time, time zones, the focus timer and synced lyrics. Each card shows what it changes.
searchNoneHint: Try a shorter word, like “dock”, “clock” or “wallpaper”.
previewNote: A scaled sketch drawn from your current settings. The menu bar and dock on your screen update as you change them.
aboutTagline: Dock and menu bar for Windows
aboutAuthor: Made by Prashant Chataut. Free software under the MIT license.
aboutPhotosBody: The wallpaper pack is fourteen photographs from Pexels, used under the Pexels License. Photographers and links are listed in ASSETS_LICENSES.md in the source.
updateOnStartupHint: A few minutes after sign-in, in the background. It never downloads or installs anything on its own.
updateReminders: Remind me when an update is available
updateRemindersHint: One Windows notification when a newer version is found, again after three days, three times at most per version.
updateEveryHint: Background look. Nothing is downloaded until you click.
updatePrereleasesHint: Test builds that arrive before a stable release and may be rough.
updatesRestarting: Setup is running. Whirlpool restarts when it finishes.
updatesRollbackHint: Downloads that release, checks its SHA-256 and installs it. Releases before 4.2 do not restart Whirlpool afterwards.
updatesPrivacy: Whirlpool sends no telemetry. Update checks go to api.github.com and downloads to github.com, and send no personal data.
wallRotationOn: Change the wallpaper on a timer
wallRotationHint: Off by default. While it is off, no timer runs.
wallEveryHint: The dock wakes once per interval to change it.
wallShuffleHint: Every picture shows once per round before any repeats.
wallDarkHint: Not set. With a folder here, the wallpaper changes when Windows switches to dark mode and back.
wallPerMonitor: A different picture on each display
wallPerMonitorHint: {version} display(s) found. Each one steps through the same source, offset from the others.
wallNextHint: Applies the next picture right away.
wallNextFailed: Windows did not accept it, or the folder has no pictures.
overlayShowHint: The overlay is a separate small window. While it is hidden nothing of it is running.
overlayHotkeyHint: Works anywhere in Windows. Needs Ctrl, Alt, Shift or Win plus a key, for example Ctrl+Shift+F10. Empty turns it off.
overlayHotkeyBad: Not a valid hotkey. Use a modifier and one key, like Ctrl+Shift+F10.
overlayPresetHint: Minimal: frames, CPU, memory. Detailed adds GPU, video memory, network, battery. One line is the minimal set in a strip.
overlayCornerHint: Drag the overlay to move it; dropped near a corner it snaps there.
overlayClickThroughHint: Mouse clicks pass to the window underneath. The overlay cannot be dragged while this is on.
overlayFullscreenHint: Works over borderless windows. Exclusive full-screen games draw over any overlay.
overlayAbout: The frame rate shown is the desktop compositor's, not the game's: per-game frame rate needs administrator-level tracing. Temperatures and power draw are not shown because Windows only exposes them through vendor drivers.
paletteHint: Search windows, apps, settings, files. Try window: or 56 KB to MB
paletteEmpty: Nothing matches. Try window: for open windows, @ for apps, / for files, > for actions, # for clipboard.
paletteSetUpdatesHint: Check, install, roll back, what is sent
paletteCalcHint: Calculator or unit conversion. Enter copies the result
paletteClipHint: Press Enter to copy it again
paletteActSettingsHint: Dock, menu bar, search and more
paletteActOverlay: Show or hide the performance overlay
paletteActOverlayHint: CPU, memory, network and frame rate
paletteActRestoreHint: Quits Whirlpool and restores the taskbar
paletteActQuitHint: Closes the dock and menu bar
paletteOnHint: One box for apps, files, actions and clipboard history.
paletteHotkeyHint: For example Ctrl+Shift+Space. Leave empty for none.
clipboardHistoryHint: Remembers your last 20 copied texts in memory only. Nothing is written to disk, and items that password managers mark as private are skipped.
tilesHint: Drag to reorder. Pick a tile to resize or remove it.
tilePick: Pick a tile to change it.
cornersHint: Rest the pointer in a corner for a moment. Nothing runs over full-screen apps.
iconStyleHint: Restyles the dock's icons. The apps' own files are never changed.
glassOnHint: Search and notifications bend what is behind them. Off gives a plain dark panel.
notifHistoryHint: Whirlpool's own alerts, and anything a script sends with whirlpool --notify.
notifEmptyHint: Alerts from Whirlpool and from scripts (whirlpool --notify) appear here.
cornersIdle: Choose an action for a corner below
overviewHint: Click a window to switch to it  ·  arrows and Enter  ·  Esc to close
paletteActOverviewHint: Every open window on one screen
hubShelfEmpty: Drop files here to keep them close.
hubShelfHint: Drop files in, drag them out to any window. They stay until you remove them; nothing is copied.
hubNoZones: Add time zones in Settings, Menu bar.
clockSecondsHint: Ticks only while the bar is on screen.
clockZones: Other time zones (three show in the bar)
clockPanel: Click the clock to open the clock panel
materialHint: Changes the dock's surface at once.
paletteActShelfHint: Keep files close for a moment
focusIsland: Show the timer beside the island
focusIslandHint: While a focus session runs, its remaining time sits next to the island. Click it to open the timer.
focusStart: Start and pause the timer in the clock panel: click the clock, or search for “focus”.
clockPlaceHint: In the menu bar, as a tile at the end of the dock, or in a pill beside the island. Click it for the clock panel. In the dock it shows hours and minutes only.
lyricsOn: Show synced lyrics in the island
lyricsOnHint: The current line replaces the track title in the island's music segment (top bar).
lyricsPrivacy: Off by default. When on, Whirlpool sends the song title, artist, album and length to lrclib.net, a public lyrics service, once per song, and nothing else: no account, no identifier. That service sees your IP address, as any website does. Lyrics are kept in memory for the current song and never saved. Turn this off and nothing is sent.
